text:
Emma: FYI — BluePoint QBR on Tue 3/31. We need token econ snapshot, 30d spend forecast, and any onboarding gaps. Who owns slides?
Raj: I can pull usage and top prompts. Any cost anomalies?
Mike: sending dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/bluepoint/costs
budget-bot: [automated] 7d spend alert — BluePoint rolling spend 2.3x expected. Threshold breached.
Sarah: Saw the alert. If that holds we should propose a $12,400/month retainer or throttle plan. Estimated monthly run rate: $12,400 based on current 30d.
Raj: Quick query I'll run:
```
SELECT date, model, tokens, cost_usd
FROM billing_events
WHERE customer='bluepoint' and date > now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY date DESC
```
Emma: Perfect. Can you also flag top 5 prompts by token count. We need recommendations: batching, quantization, or rate limits.
Noah: I'll coordinate enablement — want the convo guide and demo; can someone add a one-slider for 'cost mitigation options'?
Mike: I'll prep a technical appendix: batching config, recommended quant/perf tradeoffs, and quick commands to apply policy via API. Example config snippet:
```
PATCH /v1/customers/bluepoint/policy
{
  'max_tokens_per_minute': 100000,
  'fallback_model': 'redwood-medium-quant'
}
```
Raj: Ran the query — pasting short table:
- 2026-03-10 model: gptx-large tokens: 12.1M cost: $3,200
- 2026-03-11 model: gptx-large tokens: 9.7M cost: $2,560
- spike on 2026-03-10 due to nightly batch job (we flagged the job)
Emma: Ok, plan: Raj & Mike to produce numbers + appendix by EOD Fri. Sarah to draft cost options and pricing proposition. Noah to draft enablement play and slides. I'll consolidate into a 5-slide QBR deck and run rehearse Mon.
Sarah: +1. I'll include a 'recommended retainer tiers' table and an optional throttle SLA.
budget-bot: [automated] alert resolved — rolling spend dropped below threshold.
Emma: Awesome. Add any customer feedback (they said latency is fine but want cheaper per-request). Keep notes here. :thumbsup:
